reason: I run everything from Telegram and a notebook and it works. I have never used a CRM, and $29 a month is a big bite out of what I earn. I don't know anyone who uses this, so I'm not paying for an unknown tool.
objection: Who else uses it? I cannot find any company I know. They say 1 to 5 companies pay, and I don't want to be the one who tests it with my clients.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a shop owner I know, one of my friends, using it and telling me it saves them time, plus a free trial month with no card where they move my Telegram clients over.
